title: 第13章  破我阵法，阁下必须死！
content_zh:
“雷渊的火蛟洞窟，那可是一片禁地，相传进入其中，九死一生！”
“莫尘师兄，我们与凌涛师兄同生共死，况且他还救过我们，不管龙潭虎穴，我们都要前去营救！”
“说得对，我等同为圣堂使徒，必当一损俱损，一荣俱荣！走！”
二人说着，脚踩飞剑腾空而起。
而此时。
那一片雷渊上空，雷云时不时地降临下来，虽隔三差五，却似无止无休，每一次都发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣。
下方雷渊深处，一道人影周身层层叠叠的灵气缭绕，宛若潮汐不断游走震荡。
而每一次天雷降临下来，他的气息便飞速激增，丹田深处，第六颗灵珠也终于在磅礴雷电力量淬炼之下，在数千灵石能量的蕴养之下，变得越发璀璨。
而修炼过程中那撕心裂肺的痛苦，却也一直持续着。
当虚空之中那最庞大的一道雷云降临下来后，那承受了巨大痛苦却满脸决然之色的陆烬，忽然睁开了眼睛。
“大衍化龙诀，龙皮，凝！”
道道灵力弥漫周身，灵光四射，一股恐怖波动在身体表层凝聚起来，他周身龙膜防御逐渐被收敛进入皮肤之中，使得那皮肤都变成了雷电般的光泽！
最后一道雷霆轰然降临，雷霆轰入体内，一部分被葬天棺吞噬，一部分进入无尽丹田，而另一部分，则是化作道道细小雷蛇，在皮肤之中游走。
他所修炼的大衍化龙诀，一共有五个层次，分别是初阶，中阶，高阶，小成，大成。
而每个阶段对应修炼的部位为，皮，筋，血，骨，脏。
初阶就是炼皮。
而陆烬所凝聚出来的龙膜，正是三层炼皮的第一层。
炼皮的第二层为龙纹，第三层，龙鳞！
达到龙鳞阶段，皮肤可衍化龙鳞，防御力强如真龙。
此时，雷霆之力在皮肤中游走，那龙膜的光泽也变得更加璀璨，甚至耀眼无比，使得他整个人看上去宛若镀了一层雷光。

当雷力在丹田中最后彻底凝聚，那第六颗灵珠也彻底凝现出来，而他的气息，也水到渠成达到了六重灵珠境！
“继续！”
陆烬意犹未尽，六重灵珠境的强大气息，让他颇为满意，却并没有停滞，而是再次将一堆灵石打入葬天棺！
葬天棺内，灵力反哺而来，潮水般的力量撕裂着他的血肉之躯，虚空雷劫淬炼着他的意志，大衍化龙诀修复着不断被璀璨的身体……
狂暴的雷劫中，孕育着脱胎换骨的蜕变……
不知过去了多久。
两道人影出现在雷渊边缘。
正是莫尘和紫萱二人。
“此处雷劫太强大，莫尘师兄，以我们现在的肉身强度，根本无法承受那等天雷！”
“奇怪！这里的雷霆之力竟然如此强大，似乎之前并没有遇到过这等情况。”
“火蛟洞窟就在那雷渊深处，我等现在根本无法冲过去，若强行冲入，只有死路一条！”
“嗯？那边是什么人？好熟悉的气息……”
莫尘忽然看向不远处，在那里，一股颇为熟悉的气息让他皱起眉头。
“是毒剑十绝阵！有人在暗布毒剑十绝阵！”
“若是我所料不错的话，追杀凌涛师弟之人，正是万剑宗屠魔峰的内门长老陈江！而他最擅长的，就是利用毒剑十绝阵进行暗杀！”
“难道真的是陈江长老在暗杀凌涛师弟？”
“陈江身为万剑宗屠魔峰内门长老，善用剧毒，而血月老祖正需要这样心狠手辣之人，或许，他也是血使者成员之一！”
“既然如此，我们就先破了他这毒剑十绝阵！”
“他们阵法尚未完成，你我二人立刻联手破之！”
二人眸色冰冷，然后暗中窥视一番，终于找到那毒剑十绝阵的阵眼之所在。

“咻咻！”
二人对视一眼，眸色皆是决然，而随着二人行动，两把飞剑祭出，带着磅礴灵气，直接轰向毒剑十绝阵！
轰隆隆——
突如其来的轰鸣震惊了罗鹫几人。
“嗯？什么人胆敢破我阵法！”
他一声暴喝，忽然冲出，眼眸浮现出森寒杀意。
“毒剑十绝阵乃邪恶手段，尔等在此处设下暗阵是要害人么！”
莫尘声音如雷，操纵飞剑疯狂进攻！
“胆敢破我阵法，找死！”
罗鹫飞身而起，一拳轰来，一重金丹的实力顷刻间展露无遗！
“放肆！”
而就在这时候，紫萱一剑刺来，强大的剑气瞬间破开罗鹫一拳之威，罗鹫眼神惊愕，显然没想到这不过二十多岁的年轻女子竟有如此强大战力，立刻躲闪而去。
“什么？二品金丹之境？”
罗鹫心惊，顿感不妙！
他们一群人，修为最高的就是他，其他长老更是连金丹都没达到，更加不是对手！
“情况有变，速速发传音符！”
他没有半分拖沓，直接将传音符发出。
几人面对莫尘紫萱二人的态度也立刻发生了转变：
“不知二位是何方神圣？我等与你无冤无仇，缘何要破我阵法？”
莫尘一剑破开阵法中那凝聚起来的能量阵眼，冷声道：

“给我破！”
轰隆隆！
费了半天劲才凝聚成型的毒剑十绝阵，轰然爆炸！
恐怖的气息席卷四方，甚至将那雷渊之下正修炼的陆烬也惊动了。
此时，他丹田之中已经凝聚了第七颗灵珠，而他的修为也定格在了七重灵珠境！
当听到外面轰鸣巨响后，他停了下来，然后飞身而起，出了雷渊。
“嗯？那是……有人帮我在对付罗鹫等人？”
当他出了雷渊后，就看到此时，罗鹫几人正在被一男一女两个年轻人打压。
此处平日基本上不见人来，所以陆烬的眸色也有些意外。
不过，他倒是乐得看看热闹。
“阁下到底是何人？为何要破我阵法！”
罗鹫声音冰冷，其他几名长老也开始聚集在一起，准备共同抗敌！
“说！将我凌涛师弟逼入火蛟洞窟的，是不是你们！”
紫萱声音森冷的质问道。
“嗯？凌涛？火蛟洞窟？我们并不知晓此事！阁下如此做法未免显得太过鲁莽！”
罗鹫眸色森冷，“破我阵法，阁下必须死！”
content_en:
"The Fire Dragon Cave in Leiyuan is a forbidden area. According to legend, if you enter it, you will escape death!"
"Senior Brother Mo Chen, we live and die together with Senior Brother Lingtao. Besides, he has saved us. No matter whether it is a dragon's pond or a tiger's den, we must go to rescue him!"
"That's right. I am an apostle of the temple. I will suffer both losses and prosperity! Let's go!"
As the two of them spoke, they stepped into the air with flying swords.
And at this time.
Over the thundery abyss, thunderclouds descended from time to time. Although they came every now and then, they seemed to be endless, and every time they made a deafening roar.
In the depths of the thundery abyss below, a figure was surrounded by layers of spiritual energy, as if the tide was constantly moving and oscillating.
And every time the sky thunder came down, his aura surged rapidly, and deep in his dantian, the sixth spirit bead finally became more and more brilliant, tempered by the majestic power of thunder and lightning, and nourished by the energy of thousands of spirit stones.
However, the heart-rending pain during the cultivation process continued.
When the largest thundercloud in the void came down, Lu Jin, who had endured great pain but had a look of determination on his face, suddenly opened his eyes.
"Dayan Dragon Transformation Technique, Dragon Skin, Condensation!"
Spiritual power permeated the whole body, auras radiated, and a terrifying wave condensed on the surface of the body. The dragon membrane defense around him was gradually absorbed into the skin, making the skin turn into a lightning-like luster!
The last thunder came with a crash, and the thunder exploded into the body. Part of it was swallowed by the Sky Burial Coffin, part of it entered the endless dantian, and the other part turned into tiny thunder snakes, swimming in the skin.
The Dayan Dragon Transformation Technique he practiced has five levels in total, namely primary level, intermediate level, high level, small level, and great level.
The parts corresponding to each stage of cultivation are skin, tendons, blood, bones and internal organs.
The first level is skin refining.
The dragon membrane that Lu Jin condensed was the first layer of the three layers of skin refining.
The second layer of skin refining is dragon pattern, and the third layer is dragon scale!
After reaching the dragon scale stage, the skin can evolve into dragon scales, and the defense is as strong as a real dragon.
At this time, the power of thunder traveled through his skin, and the luster of the dragon film became even brighter, even dazzling, making his whole body look like it was coated with lightning.
When the thunder power was finally completely condensed in the dantian, the sixth spirit bead was also completely condensed, and his aura naturally reached the sixth level of spirit bead realm!
"Go on!"
Lu Jin's intention was still unfinished. He was quite satisfied with the powerful aura of the sixth-level spirit bead realm, but he did not stop. Instead, he put a bunch of spirit stones into the sky burial coffin again!
In the sky burial coffin, spiritual power came back, the tide-like power tore his flesh and blood, the Void Thunder Tribulation tempered his will, and the Dayan Transformation Dragon Art repaired the body that was constantly exposed to brilliance...
In the violent thunder tribulation, there is a completely new transformation...
I don’t know how much time has passed.
Two figures appeared on the edge of the thunder abyss.
It was Mo Chen and Zixuan.
"The thunder calamity here is too powerful. Senior Brother Mo Chen, with our current physical strength, there is no way we can withstand those thunders!"
"Strange! The power of thunder here is so powerful. It seems that we have never encountered such a situation before."
"The Fire Dragon Cave is deep in the Thunder Abyss. We can't rush through it now. If we forcefully rush in, we will only die!"
"Huh? Who is that person over there? Such a familiar smell..."
Mo Chen suddenly looked not far away, where a rather familiar aura made him frown.
"It's the Poison Sword Ten Jue Formation! Someone is setting up the Poison Sword Ten Jue Formation!"
"If my prediction is correct, the person who is chasing Junior Brother Ling Tao is none other than Chen Jiang, the inner sect elder of Wanjian Sect's Demon Slaughter Peak! And what he is best at is using the Ten Jue Formations of Poison Swords to carry out assassinations!"
"Is it really Elder Chen Jiang who is assassinating Junior Brother Ling Tao?"
"Chen Jiang, as the elder of the inner sect of Wanjian Sect's Demon Slaughter Peak, is good at using poison, and the Blood Moon Ancestor needs such a ruthless person, orXu, he is also a member of the Blood Messenger! "
"In this case, let's break his Poison Sword Ten Jue Formation first! "
"Their formation has not been completed yet, you and I will work together to break it immediately! "
The two of them looked at each other with cold eyes, and then took a peek in secret, and finally found the formation eye of the Ten Jue Formation of Poison Swords.
“Boohoo! "
The two looked at each other with determination in their eyes, and as they moved, two flying swords were launched, carrying majestic spiritual energy, directly towards the Ten Jue Formation of Poison Swords!
Rumble——
The sudden roar shocked Luo Jiu and others.
"Huh? Who dares to break my formation! "
He shouted violently and suddenly rushed out, his eyes filled with cold murderous intent.
"The Poison Sword Ten Jue Formation is an evil method. Are you setting up a secret formation here to harm people? "
Mo Chen's voice was like thunder, and he controlled the flying sword to attack wildly!
"If you dare to break my formation, you are seeking death! "
Luo Jiu flew up and struck with a punch. The strength of the golden elixir was instantly revealed!
"Presumptuous! "
At this moment, Zixuan stabbed with a sword, and the powerful sword energy instantly broke through the power of Luo Jiu's punch. Luo Jiu's eyes were shocked. It was obvious that he did not expect that this young woman in her twenties could have such strong combat power, and she immediately dodged away.
"What? The realm of second-grade golden elixir? "
Luo Jiu was frightened and felt that something was not good!
Among them, he is the one with the highest cultivation level. The other elders have not even reached the golden elixir, let alone their opponents!
"The situation has changed, send the transmission note quickly! "
He didn't hesitate at all and directly sent out the transmission talisman.
The attitudes of several people facing Mo Chen and Zixuan immediately changed:
"I wonder who the two of you are? We have no enmity or grudge against you, so why do you want to break my formation? "
Mo Chen broke through the condensed energy in the formation with a sword and said coldly:
"Break it for me! "
Boom!
The Poison Sword Ten Jue Formation, which took a long time to form, exploded!
The terrifying aura swept across all directions, even alarming Lu Jin who was practicing under the thunder abyss.
At this time, the seventh spirit bead has been condensed in his dantian, and his cultivation has been fixed at the seventh level spirit bead realm!
When he heard the loud roar outside, he stopped, then flew up and out of the thunder abyss.
"Huh? That's...someone is helping me deal with Luo Jiu and others? "
When he came out of Leiyuan, he saw that Luo Jiu and others were being suppressed by two young men, a man and a woman.
Basically no one comes here on weekdays, so Lu Jin's eyes are a little surprised.
However, he was happy to see the excitement.
"Who are you? Why do you want to break my formation! "
Luo Jiu's voice was cold, and several other elders began to gather together, preparing to fight the enemy together!
"Say! Were you the ones who forced my junior brother Ling Tao into the Fire Dragon Cave? "
Zixuan asked in a cold voice.
"Huh? Ling Tao? Fire Dragon Cave? We don't know about this! It seems too reckless for you to do this! "
Luo Jiu's eyes were cold, "If you break my formation, you must die!" "
